QOL+ Modpack

Step up your Minecraft survival with QOL+, a modpack packed with 100+ mods that make the game smoother, faster, and more immersive. Explore new biomes with Oh The Biomes We've Gone, master building with Double Doors and Jump Over Fences, and keep your gear in check with Durability Tooltip and Armour Durability. Enjoy better visuals and performance with Sodium, Lithium, and Iris, while AmbientSounds and Presence Footsteps bring the world to life. Even your inventory gets a boost with Just Enough Items and Mouse Tweaks, making survival more convenient without losing the challenge. And now there's even more copper usage: this is from the multitude of copper improvement mods, like Copper Pipes, which allow you to transfer items using them.

⚠️ Note: This modpack works best in single-player or with friends who all have QOL+ installed. Multiplayer without everyone on the pack may not function correctly, or even kick players without the pack from the game.

# Credits

Thank you so much, Zeit709 for allowing me to use your resource pack in this pack.

I did not create anything in this pack other than [Glorious Status Bars v1.6](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/glorious-status-bars), and QOL+ Panorama.
